name: Produce a video
description: Turn a request for a video into a real rendered MP4: author a versioned storyboard spec (seven scene types, evidence-bound market data with provenance), validate it, resolve bound figures, review a PNG preview, render and inspect a draft, repair a failed render within a bounded budget, render the final file and hand over its Artifact Center entry — or render the built-in BlackEclipse title card.

brief.description: The video the user asked for, in their words.

deliverFinal.description: Render the final MP4 (default: stop after a clean draft unless the user wants a deliverable).

author: eclipse
